title: Range slider example in documentation is outdated
body:
I've tried to use Range slider component example from docs (https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/react/widgets/RangeSlider.html) but there were a lot of errors in a console.
So I found current Range component version in stories and it seems to work fine.

I think that docs component is just outdated, because it worked ok with previous algolia libs versions
